subject.title: RFC 0024: Localization Runtime and Product Coverage

question: Should OpenClaw adopt RFC 0024's shared localization kernel, Gateway metadata, locale-ownership, localized package metadata, and release-gating contracts as one coordinated product direction?
rationale: The proposal intentionally spans multiple ownership and compatibility boundaries, and neither repository convention nor technical review can choose those long-term support commitments without maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Continue coordinated draft review
options.body: Keep the RFC open and draft while the named owner groups resolve each contract and document consensus in the required discussion thread.

options.title: Narrow to the shared foundation
options.body: Limit this RFC to locale resolution, message descriptors, and coverage semantics, leaving Gateway, channel ownership, plugin metadata, and release gates to separate RFCs.

options.title: Pause the centralized contract
options.body: Close or defer the RFC if maintainers prefer independent surface-local localization improvements without a shared product contract.

recommendation.title: Continue coordinated draft review
recommendation.body: Keep the RFC open and draft while the named owner groups resolve each contract and document consensus in the required discussion thread.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses core runtime, product, plugin, and release boundaries, matching the broad project and release activity visible in recent history.
